semanticRules.definition: AdmissionError code is one of invalid-arguments, capacity-exceeded, stale-view, capability-denied, unsupported-target with trusted no-dispatch proof. ProviderError phase never-admitted permits provider-unavailable, link-unresolved, abi-unverified, transport-failure only with no-dispatch proof; phase indeterminate-after-admission permits provider-unavailable or transport-failure only. Cancelled requires same owner/ticket/generation confirmed-quiescent proof; source cannot forge control outcomes.

Exactly five ordered variants: Successful(T), Failed(E), AdmissionRejected(AdmissionError), Cancelled(CancellationConfirmation), ProviderUnavailable(ProviderError); distinct from provider Result<T,E>.

Indeterminate provider admission may settle the original UI slot once as ProviderUnavailable but does not free the native ticket; no fake rollback, replay, auto retry, duplicate completion or premature disposal.
